name: Ferienwohnung Eschengrund
beschreibung:
Framed by lush meadows and forests above Lake Thiersee, Ferienwohnung Eschengrund captivates with serene quiet and modern comfort. The spacious apartment includes a sunny balcony overlooking the alpine range.

The lake's beaches and abundant hiking trails leading into surrounding alpine pastures are just minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Eschengrund in Thiersee offers nature immersion and panoramic mountain vistas in the scenic Thiersee valley.
